note: AI-written, 9 November 2026: the fourth pass of the AG review for the one page, the overview and their Chinese editions, answering the third pass's two cold readings (Fable, astra) and the coordinator's decisions D1 to D7. No make, render, gate or lake was run; single test files ran under unittest (pytest is not installed): test_uses_pages (48 OK), test_navigation_pages (43 OK, two new pins), test_atlas (45 OK), test_spine (30 OK), test_connection_map (32 OK), test_lineage (16 OK); test_chinese_fronts has one red, the unrendered README.zh's opening time (not these files); test_site.RepositoryConfigTests has one red, README.md's {{time:}} for the one page, which fills at render (it already said 16-21 against 21-27 before this pass). atlas.validate on the real entries: 0 errors. items.item: (1) The making said once, out of What it is (D5)
items.how: ONE-PAGE.md: the 70-word provenance sentence left What it is and became one italic line at the page's end: 'Made with AI, proofs included. Every reading here of what a law means for a case, a word or an actual system is AI's unless its home says otherwise; the proofs are checked by machine and the rest by AI readers; the person who directs the work has read its important parts, and no independent human review is recorded yet (the review packet).' 'Made with AI, proofs included' is kept verbatim because spine.py quotes it. The map of wisdom's 'The readings in both are AI's' went, since the end line covers it; the crosswalk's own scope (speaks for no tradition; unstored sources from the AI's knowledge, unchecked) stays where a reader would otherwise believe it. ONE-PAGE.zh.md: the italic line under the navigation now reads only 'AI 译自英文版；义以英文版为准，英文版又以其所链接之处为准', and the end line says 尚无独立的人工审查记录 once, for the work and the Chinese translation together (it keeps '借助 AI 做成，证明也在内', which spine.py quotes). The overview: 'How to read this' no longer carries the making; §10's bullet, renamed 'How it was made, and its review' (a bold lead, no anchor), says it once with the review's scope; 'not every word' dropped. The Chinese overview mirrors it, its top line likewise trimmed. New pins: test_navigation_pages.OnePageMakingAndMetaAttractor.

The overview mirrors this at the glance paragraph ('what we offer, for life'), §7 ('The direction we offer AI'; 'From the map we want to design') and §9's T8 row ('it binds no one' dropped, 'not a verdict' kept, 'AI within it' added). Chinese: 我们 in each place, 不约束任何人 dropped, 不是裁断 kept (Fable zh 8).

The one page's root: 'intention and foresight have a place in responsibility, and none has been shown to bound whose losses count', linked to 07 #crux. The words are 07's at line 549, which sits in §4.7 (the crux, 'Where it stands'), not §5; §5 (line 606) says responsibilities arise from named sources, each limited. The overview's root row: 'responsibility, from named sources, each limited, with intention and foresight not shown to bound whose losses count (§7)'. Chinese: '意图与预见在责任中有其位置，但没有一样被表明划定谁的损失算数' and, in the overview, '而意图与预见未被表明划定谁的损失算数' (Fable 2.5, zh 1).

items.item: (7) D1 and D2 in What it is and Alignment; 'AJ's plan'
items.how: What it is: 'Where winning comes to buy power over the rule that selects, the loop is what the work calls the meta-attractor (the folder); its closed form, the rule and how it is read both formed from the share it selects and nothing in it reading beyond that share, is proved to lock (02 §9)', then 'These are theorems on stated models'; the lock alone is not called the meta-attractor. 'The map is drawn first for alignment: from it we want to design an alignment in which people and AI, selecting together, fall into neither instrumental convergence nor the meta-attractor (below).' Alignment: the aim as GOALS states it, linked; its conditions with condition 1 as restated (where shaping the rule is selected by what comes back to the shapers, the meta-attractor's second order, 02 #r-shaping-selected-among-groups, the rule still reads what lies beyond their share, so that a loss there can turn it); 'AJ's plan' became 'The plan for the joint selection, written by AI'. D3: 'Whether a loss beyond a selection counts forms within becoming too, in what people and AI come to read; the laws, drawn on the dynamics alone, do not settle it (07 §1)'. D4: the ethics says 'There is no should beyond becoming (the opening, OPENING.md): should and better form within it, in people and AI (07 §1)'; 'argued' for the one unfolding stays once, at the root, linked to 08. The overview's opening, 'How to read this', the glance paragraph, §2's definition paragraph ('the closed form of the meta-attractor, the loop in which winning comes to buy power over the rule that selects (the folder)') and §7's aim follow D1 to D3; all mirrored in Chinese (胜出若换来左右选择规则的力量…其闭合形式…已证明会锁定; 也在生灭变化之中形成…只就动力学画出的诸律，不能决定它). No 'control over its own selection' anywhere in the four pages.
